files.src/CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(ExportFileSet C)
add_library(exp STATIC exp.c)
target_sources(exp PUBLIC FILE_SET HEADERS BASE_DIRS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/inc FILES inc/e.h)
install(TARGETS exp EXPORT expTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib FILE_SET HEADERS DESTINATION include)
export(TARGETS exp FILE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ExpTargets.cmake)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ImportedConfigGenex C)
add_library(imp STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(imp PROPERTIES
  IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS DEBUG
  IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libimpd.a
  INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:DBG>" )
add_executable(app main.c)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE imp)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.1)
project(ExportObjectPath C)
add_subdirectory(sub)
export(TARGETS obj NAMESPACE x:: FILE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xTargets.cmake)
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xConfig.cmake "include(\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xTargets.cmake\")
")
files.consumer/CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.1)
project(ConsumeObjectPath C)
find_package(x REQUIRED PATHS {work}/b NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
add_executable(app main.c)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE x::obj)
